freeGlobals.installCaptureHooks: called once before the first case, as the current game's acquisition tests do: the address resolver reaches worldgen, which reads GAL_SPRITES
freeGlobals.COSMIC_EPOCH: not supplied: rosters are generated through the explicit-epoch entry at epoch 0

injected.clock: activePlayMs, an integer of active-play milliseconds, given in every case input; no case reads a device clock
injected.random: a SessionRNG state { seed, ordinal, draws } given in every case input; capture draws capture.candidate then capture.success, breeding draws care.breed, a mission seal draws companion-mission three times, each planned with planSessionRNGDraws; fixedDraws are settled directly
